verdict.rationale: Formant documents several official SDKs. The Agent SDK covers telemetry ingestion, commands and teleoperation. The Python Cloud SDK covers querying and ingesting data through the APIs. The official FormantIO/toolkit GitHub repo provides a RealtimeSDK and tools for building custom apps on Formant's APIs. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, and clear evidence of language coverage beyond Python (Agent SDK languages and versioning are not stated).
